source_title: JD Vance wanted a 5th child. This is how wife Usha put a stop to it
source_excerpt:
US Vice-President JD Vance's light-hearted remarks about family life have drawn attention online, with his wife Usha Vance's response adding an unexpected twist to the couple's conversation about family planning.
US Vice-President JD Vance's joke about having a fifth baby with wife Usha Vance backfired spectacularly, after she came up with a rather permanent solution to his baby-making plans. Usha reportedly warned that if he brought up having another child while she was busy caring for their three-month-old, she would announce on X that he was getting a vasectomy.
Vance shared the exchange during an interview with Fox News, recounting how he had jokingly suggested expanding their family just a couple of days earlier.
"I would love to have six babies. I was joking with Usha just a couple of days ago, and I was like, let's just have like a fifth baby too," he said.
Recalling his wife's response, Vance said Usha had warned him against making such suggestions while their youngest child was still three months old.
"And she said, if you joke about having any more kids while this three-month-old is here, then I'm going to announce on Twitter that you're getting a vasectomy. And so, not doing that," he added.
